response:
FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - DAY

The sun beats down on the sandy shore as a lone figure, JEN, stands at the water's edge, gazing out at the ocean. She's a marine biologist, and her eyes are fixed on a jellyfish floating in the waves.

JEN
(to herself)
Ah, a moon jelly. So delicate, so ethereal.

As she reaches out a hand, the jellyfish begins to stir, its translucent body undulating in the current. Jen's eyes light up with excitement.

JEN
(whispering)
Oh, you're a beauty.

Without hesitation, Jen scoops up the jellyfish and holds it aloft, cradling it in her arms. The jellyfish thrashes about, its stinging tentacles flailing wildly.

JEN
(laughing)
Don't worry, little guy. I won't hurt you.

As she walks towards the shore, the jellyfish begins to calm, its movements slowing to a gentle sway.

JEN
( placing the jellyfish on a nearby rock)
Here, you can rest.

Jen pulls out a pair of binoculars and begins to scan the horizon. Suddenly, she gasps in awe.

JEN
(excitedly)
Oh my god, look!

A solar eclipse is unfolding before their eyes, the moon slowly creeping in front of the sun's disk. The jellyfish, sensing the change in atmosphere, begins to quiver and tremble.

JEN
( placing the binoculars aside)
I think it's time for a little show.

Jen carefully lifts the jellyfish and holds it up, positioning it directly in front of the eclipse. The jellyfish's translucent body glows with an otherworldly light as it gazes up at the darkening sun.

JEN
(smiling)
Behold, the horror beyond your comprehension.

The jellyfish's eyes, once bright and curious, begin to cloud over, its gaze fixed on some unseen terror.

JELLYFISH
(in a voice that's both ancient and eternal)
Ph'nglui mglw'nafh Cthulhu R'lyeh wgah'nagl fhtagn...

Jen's eyes widen in surprise as the jellyfish's monologue begins.

JELLYFISH
(its voice growing more frantic)
I see the void, the abyssal expanse that lies beyond the veil of reality. I see the eldritch horrors that lurk beyond the stars, waiting to consume us all.

Jen's smile falters as the jellyfish's words paint a picture of unspeakable terror.

JEN
(alarmed)
What's happening?

JELLYFISH
(its voice rising to a crescendo)
I am but a mere mortal, a fleeting moment in the grand tapestry of time. And yet, I am confronted with the abyssal void, the horrors that lurk beyond the veil of sanity.

As the jellyfish's monologue reaches its climax, it begins to dissolve into a puddle of goo, its essence dispersing into the air.

JEN
( horror-stricken)
No! Don't go!

The jellyfish's final words echo in Jen's mind as she watches in despair.

JELLYFISH
(its voice fading into the distance)
I am but a mere shell, a husk of what once was. And yet, I am left with the crushing realization that existence is but a fleeting moment, a brief flicker of consciousness in an infinite expanse of nothingness.

As the eclipse reaches its peak, Jen is left standing alone, the only sound the gentle lapping of the waves against the shore.

FADE TO BLACK.
